sections.h2: What a corporate training LMS does here
paras: A corporate training LMS puts your company's own training material in an app your employees carry, assigns it by batch, checks understanding with an assessment and shows the training head who has finished. Aura Learn is that platform, with a learner mobile app for staff and an admin dashboard for whoever runs training.

It is built around teams that are not in an office: sales reps on the road, service engineers at customer sites, branch staff in other cities. Lessons download to the phone and play offline, progress syncs when the signal returns, and a WhatsApp reminder follows anyone who has stalled. Batches can be cut by region, role or joining date, and the dashboard reports completion per batch.

sections.h2: Training that happens once, in one room, for whoever was free that day.
sections.lead: A classroom session reaches the people who could attend. Everyone hired afterwards, and everyone posted elsewhere, learns from a colleague.

items.p: The people who most need product training are on the road when the session runs at head office.

Branch managers improvise their own version, so the same product is explained five ways.

items.q: Can field staff use it without a laptop?
items.a: Yes. Employees use the learner mobile app. Lessons and documents download for offline viewing, progress syncs when the phone is back online, and quizzes are taken in the same app, so a rep or engineer never needs a desk.
Into batches you define: by region, role, branch or joining month. A course is assigned to a batch with a deadline, and the dashboard reports completion per batch so you can see which team is behind.

items.q: Is there a limit on employees?
items.a: No. Aura Learn is built for unlimited learners, so enrolling every employee, including seasonal or contract staff, does not change what you pay. Scope is agreed on a call around the modules you need.

items.q: Can it certify staff on a process or product?
items.a: Yes. A course can end in an assessment with a pass mark and a certificate, with compliance tracking that lists who has and has not passed. See the certification training platform.

Yes. Live classes and webinars run in the platform with recordings kept for the batch, so a session delivered to one region can be watched later by another, and a discussion forum carries questions afterwards.

items.q: What about training service engineers on equipment?
items.a: That is a common use, especially for medical-equipment and industrial teams that must certify engineers per model before dispatch. See healthcare training for engineer and clinical-staff certification, and training management software for assigning and tracking programmes.
